list.title: Workflows

deleteDialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete this workflow? This action cannot be undone.

bulkDeleteDialog.title: Delete {count} workflow

disabledBanner.title: Workflow is disabled

builder.title: Workflow Builder
builder.description: Click the + buttons to add and connect steps to your workflow.

executions.title: Workflow Executions
executions.description: View and manage all executions of this workflow
executions.emptyDescription: This workflow hasn't been executed yet. Enable it to start processing contacts.

settings.title: Workflow Settings
settings.triggerEventHint: The event that triggers this workflow to start for a contact
settings.allowReentryHint: When enabled, contacts can enter this workflow multiple times. When disabled, contacts can only enter once, ever.

cancelOneDialog.title: Cancel Execution
cancelOneDialog.descriptionIntro: Are you sure you want to cancel the workflow execution for {contact}?
cancelOneDialog.descriptionNote: The contact will not receive any remaining emails or actions from this workflow. This action cannot be undone.
cancelOneDialog.descriptionFallback: Are you sure you want to cancel this execution?

cancelAllDialog.title: Cancel All Active Executions
cancelAllDialog.descriptionIntro: Are you sure you want to cancel all {count} active execution?
cancelAllDialog.descriptionIntroPlural: Are you sure you want to cancel all {count} active executions?
cancelAllDialog.descriptionNote: All contacts currently in this workflow will be stopped and won't receive any remaining emails or actions. This action cannot be undone.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Workflow
deleteDialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete this workflow? This action cannot be undone.
